nodes.description: Public mapping tracking token balance for every address; mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
Public token name string 'COLOMBIA_WINS'.
Public token symbol string 'COLWII'.
Public uint8 token decimals set to 18.
Public total supply minted to the deployer at construction time.
Nested public mapping owner => spender => amount, written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Constructor; assigns the whole totalSupply to msg.sender and emits a Transfer event from address(0).
Public transfer of value tokens from msg.sender to a recipient; performs unchecked balance arithmetic.
Public approval that sets allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value.
Public delegated transfer using allowance; performs three unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic updates.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and spender throughout the contract.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value inside transfer; unchecked arithmetic on a caller-determined value.
balanceOf[to] += value inside transfer; unchecked arithmetic that can overflow the recipient balance.
balanceOf[from] -= value inside transferFrom; unchecked arithmetic on the source balance.
balanceOf[to] += value inside transferFrom; unchecked arithmetic on the destination balance.
allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value inside transferFrom; unchecked arithmetic on the allowance.
Recipient address parameter of transfer(address to, uint256 value).
Amount parameter of transfer(address to, uint256 value).
Spender address parameter of approve(address spender, uint256 value).
Amount parameter of approve(address spender, uint256 value).
Source address parameter of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value).
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value).
Amount parameter of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value).

edges.reason: Constructor reads totalSupply to determine the initial minted balance.
Constructor writes the whole supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
msg.sender is the beneficiary of the initial supply assignment and Transfer event.
transfer executes the sender balance deduction.
transfer executes the recipient balance addition.
msg.sender is the index whose balance is deducted in transfer.
value parameter is subtracted from the sender balance without overflow checks.
to parameter is the index credited in the recipient balance addition.
value parameter is added to the recipient balance without overflow checks.
Sender balance deduction writes the balanceOf mapping.
Recipient balance addition writes the balanceOf mapping.
transfer mutates the balanceOf mapping.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
msg.sender is the owner key used in allowance[owner][spender].
spender parameter is the second key of the allowance mapping.
value parameter is stored as the approved allowance amount.
transferFrom executes the source balance deduction.
transferFrom executes the recipient balance addition.
transferFrom executes the allowance decrement.
from parameter indexes the balance that is decremented without checks.
value parameter is subtracted from balanceOf[from] without overflow checks.
to parameter indexes the balance that is credited in transferFrom.
value parameter is added to balanceOf[to] without overflow checks.
msg.sender is the spender key whose allowance is decremented.
from parameter is the owner key of the allowance being decremented.
value parameter decrements allowance[from][msg.sender] without overflow checks.
Source balance deduction writes the balanceOf mapping.
Recipient balance addition writes the balanceOf mapping.
Allowance decrement writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom mutates the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom mutates the allowance mapping.
msg.sender is the spender checked against allowance[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.

normalization_plan.reason: The transfer recipient parameter exists only to index the recipient balance mutation and should be folded into that unsafe operation.
The transfer value parameter is a transient amount consumed by the sender balance deduction and should be folded into that unsafe operation.
The spender parameter is only used to key the allowance write inside approve and should be folded into the approve function.
The approve value parameter is only used to set allowance inside approve and should be folded into the approve function.
The transferFrom from parameter only indexes the source balance decrement and should be folded into that unsafe operation.
The transferFrom to parameter only indexes the destination balance credit and should be folded into that unsafe operation.
The transferFrom value parameter is consumed by the allowance decrement and related balance updates and should be folded into that unsafe operation.
